system.roleplaying: You owe someone or something more than you can ever repay. You know plenty of folks willing to give out favors, but it'll cost you later.
system.minorTwist: What potential source of wealth looks mighty tempting right about now?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Debtor
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome in a situation related to repaying a debt and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
